game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway, a vine-choked archway: the rune scholar must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of carved tiles while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway: a vine-choked archway
core_gameplay_loop: In Overgrown Archway, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of carved tiles while keeping the order. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the rune gate using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The rune gate reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the rune gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Overgrown Archway'.
